x: Young Barry Freeman walked well in the 2 miles boys race to record 19.05. The following Wednesday Ray Middleton won the Civil Service v R.A.F. v M.P.A.A. fixture over 10 miles, recording 79.06.

13 year old Barry Freeman came under the judges eye in the Essex Beagles open walk Boys 1¾ mile at Chigwell Row on January 7th. But he has the right spirit, and his name should be worth following in future events.
